lines.note: Two squads plus a shared platform team from Q4.

Overrun driven by the extra non-production environment.
Branch training starts ahead of cutover.
Drawn down for the second migration rehearsal.

notes.author: P. Nallathamby
notes.text: Licence invoice for the additional UAT environment booked against SW-01 rather than INF-01.

notes.author: Finance Ops
notes.text: Northwind rate card increased 4% from 1 Jan; SOW-4 ceiling unchanged.

notes.author: R. Tan
notes.text: Contingency drawdown of 85k approved by the steering committee for rehearsal 2.

risks.title: Deposits data quality below migration threshold
risks.description: Legacy deposit records carry inconsistent customer identifiers - reconciliation fails for roughly 3% of accounts.
risks.mitigation: Data remediation squad running weekly cleansing cycles against the golden source.

risks.title: Corelis release slips past cutover window
risks.description: Vendor roadmap places the 9.4 release two weeks before the planned cutover.
risks.mitigation: Contractual milestone added to SOW-4; fallback is cutover on 9.3 with a deferred upgrade.

risks.title: MAS notice 655 reporting not covered by the target state
risks.description: Regulatory reporting extract has no equivalent in the target platform.
risks.mitigation: Gap analysis with compliance completed; bespoke extract scoped for release 3.

risks.title: Single point of knowledge on the payments interface
risks.description: Only one engineer understands the ISO 20022 mapping layer.

risks.title: Parallel run infrastructure cost overrun
risks.description: Running both platforms through Q2 doubles the compute footprint.
risks.mitigation: Reserved instances purchased for the parallel-run months; nightly shutdown of non-prod.

risks.title: Branch staff readiness for cutover weekend
risks.description: Training completion is behind plan in the eastern branches.
risks.mitigation: Additional weekend sessions scheduled; branch champions identified per site.

risks.title: Privileged access review overdue for migration accounts
risks.description: Service accounts created for migration have not been through the quarterly access review.
risks.mitigation: Access review booked with the CISO office for July; accounts time-boxed to cutover plus 30 days.

risks.title: Interest accrual differences between platforms
risks.description: Rounding differs on term deposits, producing small but visible customer-facing variances.
risks.mitigation: Rounding rules aligned in release 2 and confirmed across two rehearsals.

risks.title: Northwind key staff rotation
risks.description: Two senior integrator staff rolled off at the end of the last SOW period.
risks.mitigation: Replacements onboarded in February with a four-week handover.

risks.title: Cutover rollback window shorter than rehearsal time
risks.description: Rehearsal 1 took 19 hours against a 14-hour rollback window.
risks.mitigation: Rehearsal 2 targeted parallelised data load; runbook re-sequenced to bring the critical path under 12 hours.

risks.title: Customer statement formatting differences
risks.description: Target platform statements differ in layout - complaints risk at first statement run.
risks.mitigation: Pre-cutover customer communication drafted with the marketing team.

risks.title: Third-party card switch certification lapses
risks.description: Certification with the card switch expires before the revised cutover date.

reports.author: Rachel Tan
reports.executive_summary: Apollo closes the quarter on plan. The target platform is stood up in all non-production environments, the first two migration release candidates are through system test, and the integrator team reached full complement in November. Spend tracks slightly below profile because the training workstream starts later than planned. The main watch item is deposit data quality, where reconciliation is still failing for a small but stubborn share of accounts.
progress: Target platform provisioned across development, system test and UAT, with the additional non-production environment agreed with Corelis.
Release 1 (customer and account master) passed system test with 94% of test cases green.
Data remediation squad stood up; first cleansing cycle reduced identifier mismatches from 5.1% to 3.4% of deposit accounts.
Integrator team at full complement following two onboardings in November.
issues: Corelis has not yet confirmed the 9.4 release date, which affects the cutover plan.
The additional UAT environment invoice was booked against the licence code rather than infrastructure, distorting the cost split.
next_period: Complete release 2 build and enter system test.
Run the second data remediation cycle and re-baseline the reconciliation target.
Agree the cutover window with operations and the card switch provider.
reports.budget_note: Approved at the October investment committee.
reports.forecast_note: Assumes the training workstream lands in Q1.

reports.author: Rachel Tan
reports.executive_summary: The project moves to amber this quarter. Release 2 is in system test a fortnight later than planned, and the first cutover rehearsal ran nineteen hours against a fourteen-hour rollback window, which is the single biggest threat to the December date. Deposit data quality continues to improve. A regulatory gap on MAS Notice 655 reporting has been confirmed and scoped into release 3, which adds scope without adding budget.
progress: Release 2 (deposits and term products) in system test, two weeks behind the plan agreed in December.
Cutover rehearsal 1 executed end to end; the runbook completed but exceeded the rollback window.
Compliance gap analysis for MAS Notice 655 completed with a bespoke extract scoped into release 3.
Branch training material signed off and pilot sessions run in two western branches.
issues: Rehearsal 1 exceeded the rollback window; a second rehearsal is needed before the cutover date can be confirmed.
Release 3 has absorbed regulatory scope with no corresponding budget change.
The payments interface remains dependent on a single engineer.
next_period: Re-sequence the cutover runbook and rehearse again with a parallelised data load.
Freeze release 3 scope including the MAS 655 extract.
Cross-train a second engineer on the ISO 20022 mapping layer.

reports.author: Rachel Tan
reports.executive_summary: Apollo remains amber with a credible path back to green. The re-sequenced runbook brought cutover rehearsal 2 down to eleven hours, inside the rollback window, and release 2 completed user acceptance. Contingency was drawn down for the first time to fund the second rehearsal. Licence spend has now exceeded its line budget, offset by underspend in training and contingency at portfolio level. Cutover remains planned for the December window subject to card switch re-certification in August.
progress: Cutover rehearsal 2 completed in 11 hours with the parallelised data load, inside the 14-hour rollback window.
Release 2 user acceptance signed off by deposits and branch operations.
Deposit reconciliation failures down to 1.2% of accounts after the third cleansing cycle.
Second engineer onboarded to the payments interface with a four-week shadowing plan.
issues: Licence spend has passed the SW-01 line budget; a virement from contingency is requested.
Card switch re-certification in August is on the critical path to the December cutover.
Privileged access review for migration service accounts is overdue.
next_period: Complete card switch re-certification and confirm the cutover date.
Close the privileged access review with the CISO office.
Begin branch training at scale across the eastern region.
reports.budget_note: Includes the 85k contingency drawdown approved in May.
reports.forecast_note: Forecast assumes no third rehearsal is required.
